method:
Generated by a deterministic script over android/jadx-out (jadx default mode) - the same inputs give the same ids. apk_refs: Java paths are relative to android/jadx-out/sources/, resource paths start with resources/ (relative to android/jadx-out/). Line numbers are located by regex at generation time. Id = mgmt:<kind>:<key>, key always taken from the code/resource identifier, never from prose.
Mechanical (closed) groups - a rerun MUST reproduce exactly these sets:
(1) cfgop:<hex> = every 'public static final (int|byte) CONFIG_*' in no/nordicsemi/android/mesh/opcodes/ConfigMessageOpCodes.java (71); class name derived by CamelCase (Appkey->AppKey, Netkey->NetKey, Polltimeout->PollTimeout); usage = non-Nordic files (files containing 'no.nordicsemi' outside no/) referencing that class as a whole word; unreferenced => 'NOT USED'.
(2) proxyop:<hex> = ProxyConfigMessageOpCodes.java constants (4).
(3) provpdu:<hex> = ProvisioningState.TYPE_PROVISIONING_* + PROVISIONING_FAILED(9); provfail:<hex> = ProvisioningFailedState.ProvisioningFailureCode enum; provauth:<hex> = utils/AuthenticationOOBMethods enum; provalg = utils/AlgorithmType enum.
(4) proxypdu:<n> / proxysar:<n> = MeshManagerApi PDU_TYPE_* and GATT_SAR_{COMPLETE,START,CONTINUATION,END}.
(5) gatt:<uuid> = every UUID.fromString in de/jung/common/c.java + MeshManagerApi.MESH_PROVISIONING_UUID/MESH_PROXY_UUID.
(6) const:<file>.<name> = every 'static final (int|byte|long|short) NAME = <number>' in LowerTransportLayer, UpperTransportLayer, MeshTransport, ProvisionedBaseMeshNode, MeshManagerApi, SecureNetworkBeacon, UnprovisionedBeacon, MeshBeacon, opcodes/TransportLayerOpCodes, utils/ProxyFilterType, transport/PublicationSettings, excluding TAG, CREATOR, PDU_TYPE_*, GATT_SAR_{COMPLETE,START,CONTINUATION,END}, MESH_*_UUID (covered by 4/5).
(7) model:<hex4> = models/SigModelParser.java 'static final short' constants with value < 0x100, 0x1200..0x1202 or 0x1400..0x14FF.
(8) appop:<hex> = ApplicationMessageOpCodes constants named TIME_* or HEALTH_*.
(9) api:<class>.<method> = public methods declared in MeshManagerApi or MeshNetwork(+BaseMeshNetwork), excluding on*/notify*/equals/hashCode/clone/run/toString/describeContents/writeToParcel and get* (except getters with a note), that are invoked as '.<method>(' in any java file outside no/, androidx/, com/, kotlin*; names declared in both classes are attributed to MeshManagerApi only if the receiver text contains 'eshManagerApi', otherwise to MeshNetwork; MeshNetwork calls only count in files that mention 'MeshNetwork'.
(10) debug:<vm>.<method> = every file de/jung/junghome/app/ui/meshnetwork/**/<X>ViewModel$<method>$*.java (method not 'special'/'state'/'internalStateFlow'); plus hand items debug:ivindexbump, ivupdatetestmode, resetnetwork, exportlogfile, exportdatabase, entry for the inline click cases of meshnetwork/ViewOnClickListenerC1872d.java.
(11) flow:<name> = top-level (no '$') classes in de/jung/junghome/domain/interactors/{networking,update,configuration,devices/provisioning}/, de/jung/junghome/data/{mesh (excl. resolver/),bluetooth}/ and the files ScanUnprovisionedDevices, EnsureTimeKeeper, RequestSoftwareVersion, RequestUnknownSoftwareVersionForUpdates, KeepLowPowerDeviceAwake, SleepMode, ResetNetwork, RemoveInvalidDevices, UpdateConnectionInterval, ObserveDeviceConnectionState, ObserveBluetoothState, connection/SetProxySettings, manufacturer/{RequestManufacturerInfos,CommunicateWithDevice}, de/jung/common/FlowOperatorsKt, app/service/{AppStartService,TimeKeeperService}, domain/item/DeviceSetupProgress; name = file stem, or the 'compiled from: X.kt' name for obfuscated stems; classes whose declaration extends *Exception/*Error/Throwable and *Error/*Step files go to err instead; R8 synthetic skipped. The script aborts if any such class lacks a note.
(12) err:<outer>.<inner> = every 'class X extends *(Error|Exception|Throwable)' in the flow file set.
(13) setup:<state> = DeviceSetupProgress subclasses. builder:<kotlin name> = files compiled from *Builder.kt whose 'return new' messages include Config*/ProxyConfig*/Time(Set|Get|RoleStatus*) or whose name matches (Version|Battery|DaylightSaving|Manufacturer(Name|HardwareRevision|Software)).
(14) timing:<flow>:<ms> = every literal '\b\d{3,}L\b' and every 'c.L(n, DurationUnit.SECONDS)' (n*1000) in all files (incl. $ inner classes) of the flow set, keyed by owning class; script aborts if a literal lacks an item or an item is stale.
(15) fwimage:<file_name> = resources/assets/updates/*_update.json; fwjson:<entity>.<key> = Gson @c("...") / plain fields of data/model/{UpdateDeviceEntity,FileInfoEntity,UpdateInfoEntity,ProductEntity,RequirementEntity,StorageSchemaVersionEntity}; fwimagetype = domain/dto/ImageType enum; versioncmp = update/VersionComparison enum.
(16) Enums: timerole (domain/item/mesh/TimeRole subclasses), krphase (RefreshPhase), proxyfilter (nodes/models/configuration/proxy/FilterType), battery (BatteryStatusIndicator), blestate (X7/a.java DeviceState subclasses). pref:<key> = the mgmt-relevant keys of K7/i.java (lb_connect_prefs): enable_force_update, show_update_for_all_devices, request_all_software_versions, show_mesh_network_cell, shown_proxy_screen_for_network_id, use_status_message_optimization, ble_never_ask_again.
(17) SECOND SWEEP (resource angle): str:<name> = every resources/res/values/strings.xml key matching ^(device_setup_progress_|deviceSetupStep|update_|add_devices_provisioning_|identify_device_hint_|proxy_|no_proxy_connection$|node_debug_|settings_(start_iv|enable_iv|disable_iv|renewal_key|error_key_renewal|reset_network|show_update|enable_force_update|show_mesh_network|mesh_network|connection_status|disconnect_from_device|updates)|device_reset_manually|common_perform_hardware_reset|device_not_reachable|device_firmware_update_caution|timekeeper_|no_timekeeper_|configuration_time_keeper_|error_(prohibited|invalid_pdu|invalid_format|confirmation_failed|decryption_failed|unexpected_error|cannot_assign_addresses|rfu)$|bluetooth_turn_on|permissions_bluetooth|unprovisioned_device_low_power_device_warning|gateway_update_|switch_layout_provisioning_header|common_update_required|common_continue_to_update). This sweep surfaced the gateway 'Updates' stub screen (fwui), the node-debug bootloader/secure-element/STM versions (builders), battery-check OTA gating and the IV-index debug actions, which were then added as items. A third sweep over class names (grep -rl 'compiled from: .*Builder.kt'; 'extends .*Exception') and constants (static final grep above) produced groups 12-14.
Hand-curated (explicit list, keyed by Nordic/JUNG identifier): nordic:<Class>.<method> = SecureNetworkBeacon.<init>/canOverwrite/isMinimumTimeRequirementCompleted, MeshManagerApi.parseNotifications/identifyNode/updateNetworkKeySecurity, IvIndex.getTransmitIvIndex, LowerTransportLayer.isValidSeqAuth/initSegmentedAccessAcknowledgementTimer/parseLowerTransportLayerPDU, MeshMessageState.executeResend, BlockAcknowledgementMessage.getSegmentsToBeRetransmitted, ProvisionedMeshNode.incrementSequenceNumber, NetworkLayer.createNetworkLayerPDU, NetworkKey.getTxDerivatives, UnprovisionedBeacon.<init>, SecureUtils.calculateHash/calculateK3; and misc items advtype:1..3 (LBCAdvertisementData types), discovery:*, bind:applist (P7/a.java:27), proxy:*, provisioner:randomaddress, seq:import, ivindex:local, time:*, ble:*, scan:settings, msg:vendorgenericstatus, setup:namingafterprovision, fwui:gatewaydetailupdatefragment.
Coroutine bodies jadx could not decompile (e.g. KeepLowPowerDeviceAwake$work$1) were read from a 'jadx --decompilation-mode simple' run; such facts are marked '(simple-mode ...)' and cited at the default-mode file.
Scope note: only what the APK contains is listed; 'NOT USED' marks library capability the app never exercises (e.g. heartbeat, friend, LPN, node identity set, net/app key add/delete/update, health fault get, time zone set, private beacon/SAR/DFU models). On-air items seen in docs/parity/captures-inventory.json but absent from the app (Heartbeat control PDUs and Config Heartbeat Publication/Subscription Get/Set/Status 0x8038/0x8039/0x803A/0x803B/0x06/0x803C, Health Fault Get/Status 0x8031/0x05, PB-ADV) are therefore represented only by their NOT-USED/unhandled items (cfgop:*, appop:*, nordic:lowertransportlayer.parselowertransportlayerpdu, nordic:unprovisionedbeacon.init). VERIFICATION SWEEP (adversarial re-check; items appended after the sorted generated block, ids built by the same rules): (18) const:<class>.<name> also for every numeric static final (excluding OP_CODE and *_LENGTH) of these further Nordic classes whose topic is mgmt: MeshProvisioningHandler, BaseMeshNetwork, Features, NetworkKey, provisionerstates/ProvisioningCapabilities, transport/{ConfigCompositionDataGet, ConfigCompositionDataStatus, ConfigGattProxySet, ConfigModelAppStatus, ConfigRelaySet, TimeStatus}, utils/{AlgorithmInformationParser, Heartbeat, NetworkTransmitSettings, ParsePublicKeyInformation, ParseStaticOutputOOBInformation, RelaySettings, SecureUtils} and utils/MeshParserUtils names matching TTL|RESOLUTION (found by grep -rnE "static final (int|long|short|byte) [A-Z_0-9]+ = -?[0-9]+" over no/nordicsemi/android/mesh minus the group-6 classes; the rest were assigned elsewhere: opcodes -> cfgop/appop, *_LENGTH/OP_CODE -> msg, MeshAddress -> net, ApplicationMessage/GenericOnOffStatus/LightLCLightOnOffStatus/GlobalAltitude -> msg, MeshParserUtils GENERIC_ON_OFF_5_MS/IV_ADDRESS_*/UNICAST_ADDRESS_MIN unused). (19) provoutaction/provinaction/provstaticoob/provpubkeyoob:<name> = enum constants of utils/{OutputOOBAction, InputOOBAction, StaticOOBType, PublicKeyOOB}. (20) err: classes extending Exception in domain/item/bluetooth/LBCAdvertisementData and domain/interactors/manufacturer/RequestManufacturerInfoError (error files next to the flow set that group 12 did not scan: grep -rlE "class \w+ extends \w*(Error|Exception|Throwable)" over domain/interactors, data/mesh, data/bluetooth, app/service, domain/item/bluetooth; every other hit belongs to cloud/scene/timer/schedules/user/connection/group/demo/project = other domains); advtype:unknown = the LBCAdvertisementData fallback branch. (21) timing literals re-swept in a jadx --decompilation-mode simple run (--no-res) over the same flow file set: L(n, DurationUnit.SECONDS) -> n*1000, L(n, DurationUnit.MILLISECONDS) -> n, and numeric first arguments of calls that are multiples of 100 or 120/150/300/500; only KeepLowPowerDeviceAwake 6000 was new. (22) str: second resource sweep with the token regex (^|_)(iv|ivindex|key_?renewal|renewal|refresh|reset|remov|provision|proxy|mesh|node|connection|connect|bluetooth|ble|timekeeper|time_keeper|time|dst|daylight|update|firmware|version|relay|ttl|beacon|network|sequence|seq|identity|identify|ota|battery|wake|sleep|reachable|unreachable|composition|configur|setup|scan|rssi|signal|oob|filter)(_|$) over strings.xml keys minus the inventory: the mgmt ones are exactly ^(no_ble_snackbar_|settings_ble_title$|error_(empty|invalid)_iv_index$|error_empty_network_key$|settings_(network_key|export_network|import_network)$|device_update_|connection_temperature_update_required_|settings_activate_admin_mode_for_update|device_parameter_sensor_values_for_gateway_version_info$|force_update_|min_required_version$|version_name_incorrect$); the other hits are blind/timer/threshold/scene/gateway-network/QR/lock/rocker texts owned by the ui/prod/prop inventories. Also checked and found complete: Nordic imports of JUNG code (446 files outside no/, androidx/, com/, kotlin*), mutating calls on Nordic objects, debug ViewModels without $method$ files (UpdateDebugViewModel, BannerDebugViewModel, MeshDebugViewModel: prefs only), interactor directories, AndroidManifest services/receivers.

items.title: JUNG manufacturer AD type 1
items.details: Manufacturer-specific AD (0xFF) parsed by LBCAdvertisementData: total 7 B: vendorId u16 LE 0x0527, advType 1, productId u16, actuatorFunctionId u8, buttonLayout u8. Any other type/length -> ActuatorFunctionId Unknown / LayoutMode UNKNOWN.

items.title: JUNG manufacturer AD type 2
items.details: Manufacturer-specific AD (0xFF) parsed by LBCAdvertisementData: total 9 B: vendorId, advType 2, productId u16, actuatorFunctionId u16, buttonLayout u16. Any other type/length -> ActuatorFunctionId Unknown / LayoutMode UNKNOWN.

items.title: JUNG manufacturer AD type 3
items.details: Manufacturer-specific AD (0xFF) parsed by LBCAdvertisementData: total 15 B: vendorId, advType 3, productId, actuatorFunctionId u16, buttonLayout u16, MAC 6 B (reversed); MAC lets the app re-identify a device (previousMac) after OTA/reset even when vendorId does not match. Any other type/length -> ActuatorFunctionId Unknown / LayoutMode UNKNOWN.

items.title: TIME_SET (0x5C)
items.details: TIME_SET = 0x5C. SENT. TimeMessageBuilder (p234v7/M0) TimeSet(appKey, MeshTAITime): unicast to Time Server of each newly configured device (ConfigureDevice SetTime), after OTA confirm, broadcast unacknowledged to 0xFFFF on every proxy connect (LoadInitialDeviceState), debug sendDateTime. See mgmt:time:taitime.

items.title: TIME_STATUS (0x5D)

items.title: TIME_GET (0x8237)
items.details: TIME_GET = 0x8237. SENT only from debug (getDeviceTime / requestTime).

items.title: TIME_ROLE_GET (0x8238)
items.details: TIME_ROLE_GET = 0x8238. SENT from debug getTimeRole (TimeRoleMessageBuilder p234v7/N0).

items.title: TIME_ROLE_SET (0x8239)
items.details: TIME_ROLE_SET = 0x8239. SENT. TimeRoleStatusSet(role): 2 = Mesh Time Relay on the elected time keeper, 3 = Mesh Time Client when a keeper is removed (UpdateTimeRole / TimeKeeperConfiguration).

items.title: TIME_ROLE_STATUS (0x823A)

items.title: ConfigureControlSwitchFunctionality

items.title: ConfigureControlSwitchLayout
items.details: Admin Set 0x5001 ButtonLayout (unack) followed by full re-provisioning because the element layout changes; errors ButtonLayoutUpdateFailed/ReprovisioningFailed.

items.title: ConfigureDetector
items.details: Detector defaults at end of configuration: factory OnOff Client publication -> load element group + KeyMode, Admin 0x6021 DetectorRepetitionTime = 50, 0x100B ManualOffEnable = true, lamps 0x1007 TimedOnDuration = 120 s.

items.title: ConfigureDevice
items.details: Post-provisioning step machine (see mgmt:setup:*). Before first step SetProxySettings (black list). Steps: SetWhitelistFilter (AppKey Add, white list + add {provisioner, 0xFFFF}) -> RequestCompositionData (page 0 + bind list) -> SetConfiguration (GATT Proxy 1, AppKey Add, Default TTL 5, Relay 1/3/90 ms, Net Transmit 3/100 ms) -> SetBlacklistFilter (black list, Beacon Set = !lowPower) -> RequestRequiredData (InsertId 0x0002, ButtonLayout 0x5001) -> SetTime -> CreateElementGroups (30 s budget) -> FinishConfiguration -> DisableProxy -> ReconnectToDevice -> Finished. RETRY_COUNT = 2 for the chain; final failure -> ProvisioningNotStarted + ResetDevice(id,false).

items.title: ConfigureGateway
items.details: Reads gateway network credentials over mesh (LBC manufacturer props 0xC001 token, 0xC002 IP, 0xC003 fingerprint), 3 s timeout; error CouldNotReceiveData.

items.title: ConfigureMiniActuatorConnection
items.details: Mini actuator input wiring (connections domain); errors ButtonLayoutUpdateFailed/ConnectionFailed.

items.title: ConfigureSocket
items.details: Measuring socket initial unacknowledged reads (0x006D, 0x006A, sensor 0x0081, energy charts).

items.title: ConnectToDevice
items.details: Connect to a node by MAC for configuration/OTA: Params.Any(scan 15 s, MAC blacklist) or Params.Specific(mac, timeout default 180 s, ...). Scan without filter, accept first advert with that MAC and 0x1828 service data matching the network, connect, wait 5 s for Connected, then SetProxySettings (black list).

items.title: ConnectToDeviceTypeGroup
items.details: Subscribes device servers to the fixed device-type groups 0xFEF5..0xFEF9.

items.title: ConnectToLowPowerDeviceForUpdate
items.details: Battery devices before OTA: progress WakeUpDevice (ConfigGattProxySet(1) via mesh so it starts advertising, user presses button) -> CheckBatteryStatus (Generic Battery Get; BatteryStatusIndicator GOOD ok, LOW ok with "low" hint, CRITICAL -> Error.LowBatteryStatus, UNKNOWN/none -> Error.NoBatteryStatus) -> Finished(lowBattery). retryWhen except LowBatteryStatus.

items.title: ConnectToProxy
items.details: Proxy connection loop. Combines BLE connection state, IsBleProcessRunning, scan errors, Bluetooth on/off and device list; when Disconnected/CommunicationError/FailedToConnect, BT on and devices exist: scan (no HW filter, software filter on service UUID 0x1828), accept an advert only if its 0x1828 service data matches the network (Network ID of current or old NetKey, or Node Identity of a known node) AND its MAC is a known device MAC; connect and wait 5 s for Connected, then SetProxySettings. First match wins (no RSSI ranking). On any error: log "Retry to connect to proxy", cancel scan, wait 5 s, retry forever.

items.title: DeviceDiscoveringImpl
items.details: Unprovisioned discovery: 0x1827 service data -> device UUID (first 16 bytes), RSSI classes >=-30/-70, JUNG manufacturer AD (0xFF, company 0x0527) parsed by LBCAdvertisementData; keyed by MAC.

items.title: DeviceProvisioning
items.details: Provision identified device: 30 s timeout; unicast = nextAvailableUnicastAddress(nodes.size(), provisioner) (+1 on collision); startProvisioningNoOOB; on failure disconnect + ResetDevice(id,false); then disconnect and reconnect to the new node as proxy.

items.title: DeviceProvisioningToPreventAdvertisingTimer
items.details: Forced-update path for unprovisioned devices: DeviceProvisioning then UpdateDeviceSettingsForForcedUpdate so the node keeps advertising (prevents the unprovisioned advertising timer from expiring) before OTA.

items.title: DeviceSetupProgress
items.details: Sealed state set of device setup (see mgmt:setup:*).

items.title: DeviceSetupServiceImpl
items.details: Holds DeviceSetupProgress state flow and publishes (node UUID, MAC of the GATT peer) at provisioning complete; MAC stored in deviceentity.macAddress and exported as meta.devices[].macAddress.

items.title: DisableProxy
items.details: ConfigGattProxySet(0) when condition holds (low-power devices: wall transmitters, battery mini actuator/puck).

items.title: EnsureTimeKeeper
items.details: Time keeper election only while legacy PP2 nodes (PID 0x0010..0x0014) exist; priority MiniActuatorHardwired, SwitchMeasureSocket, SwitchSocket, MotionDetector, PresenceDetector, TwoGangRocker, OneGangRocker, Rtr; never gateway or battery devices.

items.title: FlowOperatorsKt
items.details: sendWithTimeoutRetry(attempts, timeoutMs): each attempt under withTimeout; after last attempt MaxRequestTimeoutException.

items.title: GatewayAPI
items.details: Retrofit HTTPS API of the gateway (config/healthstatus) - gateway domain, listed because it lives in data/mesh/api.

items.title: IdentifyDevice
items.details: Connect by MAC (retry 3 x 200 ms), read DIS 0x2A28 software version (and JUNG STM32 char for RTR) with 3 s timeouts, identifyNode (Invite, attention 5 s), wait <=5 s for Capabilities, whole identify retried 3 times (RETRY_COUNT).

items.title: IsBleProcessRunning
items.details: Combines "setup/update running", OTA-in-progress flag, and other BLE busy flags; while true ConnectToProxy does not (re)connect.

items.title: JungHomeMeshLogger
items.details: Nordic MeshLogger handler -> app log (Timber); the debug screen can export logfile.txt.

items.title: JungMeshApiImpl
items.details: Capability -> MeshMessage via builders; destination: config -> node primary unicast, proxy config -> 0x0000, app messages -> capability address; global TID counter (byte, +1 per SET); SetProxySettings sends ProxyConfigSetFilterType(1) expecting status 0x03 from the proxy unicast.

items.title: KeepLowPowerDeviceAwake
items.details: While a battery device screen is open: acknowledged keep-alive REQUEST every 6 s (simple-mode KeepLowPowerDeviceAwake$work$1: c.L(6, SECONDS)); emits SleepMode DeviceAwake / DeviceNotAwake / DeviceNotAvailable.

items.title: KeyRenewal
items.details: Manual NetKey refresh (debug button only). Phases (RefreshPhase): 0 NORMAL_OPERATION -> distributeNetKey(primary, random 16 B) + ConfigNetKeyUpdate to all non-excluded nodes; 1 KEY_DISTRIBUTION -> ConfigKeyRefreshPhaseSet(2); 2 USING_NEW_KEYS -> ConfigKeyRefreshPhaseGet on all nodes, abort if any node < USING_NEW_KEYS, else local switchToNewKey; 3 REVOKE_OLD_KEYS -> ConfigKeyRefreshPhaseSet(3) + local revokeOldKey; then ExportProjectToCloudStorage. AppKeys are never refreshed (no ConfigAppKeyUpdate). Beacon KR flag ignored.

items.title: LoadInitialDeviceState
items.details: ON-CONNECT sequence (from ProxyConnectionLoadingViewModel after a proxy connection): CheckForValidProject -> wait until import/export coordinator idle -> wait BLE state Connected -> Time Set broadcast UNACKNOWLEDGED to 0xFFFF with current TAI time -> for each non-low-power Gateway: GatewayNetworkCapability REQUEST (0xC001/0xC002/0xC003 via LBC manufacturer props) -> LoadStateForDevices for devices with M1()=true. Also stores the mesh network id in pref shown_proxy_screen_for_network_id (proxy loading screen shown once per network).

items.title: LoadStateForDevices
items.details: Initial state poll after connect: per device acknowledged Gets (Generic OnOff Get, blind level, actual temperature ...), 300 ms delay between requests, retryWhen up to (#devices x 3); errors LoadAllDevicesNotReachable / LoadStateFailed.

items.title: MeshMessagesUtils
items.details: Empty utility holder.

items.title: MeshMessengerImpl
items.details: Request queue: MutableSharedFlow(extraBufferCapacity 300), ONE request in flight; fails fast with DeviceNotReachable when proxy not connected (non-battery target); auto-binds unbound models (ConfigModelAppBind, 3 s); sendWithTimeoutRetry(3 attempts, 3000 ms) -> MaxRequestTimeoutException marks device unreachable.

items.title: MeshNotificationChannel
items.details: MeshStatusCallbacks: onMeshMessageReceived -> resolvers; block-ack processed/received, decryption failures, transaction failed, unknown PDU (e.g. Heartbeat control) are only logged. waitForStatusMessage: src == expected && (opcode == expected || vendor generic status 0xD12705).

items.title: MeshRequest
items.details: Acknowledged(dst, msg, statusOpCode, statusSrc) / Unacknowledged(dst, msg).

items.title: MessageState
items.details: Enum SENDING / SENT.

items.title: NodeProvisioningServiceImpl
items.details: Nordic provisioning callbacks: identify, startProvisioning, onProvisioningCompleted (name node, publish uuid+MAC), failures -> FailedProvisioning.

items.title: NodeVersionInfo
items.details: Data class (deviceId, productIdentifier, versionCode, stm32 version) used by update checks.

items.title: NoProvisionerErrorChannel
items.details: SharedFlow reporting PrepareMeshNetwork.NoProvisionerFoundForUserException (participant imported a project without its provisioner) -> AppStartService dialog.

items.title: ObserveBluetoothState
items.details: Bluetooth adapter on/off; BT off -> BluetoothOffActivity lock screen.

items.title: ObserveDeviceConnectionState
items.details: BLE connection state X7.a: Connecting, Connected(mac), Disconnecting, Disconnected(expected), FailedToConnect(reason), CommunicationError(status).

items.title: ObserveMeshNetwork
items.details: Observes the Nordic MeshNetwork (V7.p domain object incl. JungIvIndex).

items.title: ObserveNotificationChannel
items.details: Exposes MeshNotificationChannel stream of received mesh messages.

items.title: ObserveUpdateAvailable
items.details: Emits whether any device has an update: manifest version GREATER than device version (STM32 version for image_type stm), or always when pref show_update_for_all_devices is set; debounced 1 s.

items.title: PrepareMeshNetwork
items.details: Params CreateNetworkIfNotExist / ResetProvisioners / SelectUserProvisioner. Creates provisioner (name = android_id, random unicast in own range; ranges unicast min((0x7FFF-1)/10, free), group 0xC000..0xFEF4, scene) or selects provisioner by cloud provisionerId; waits max 3 s for the network with selected provisioner, 10 s in selectProvisioner; missing -> NoProvisionerFoundForUserException.

items.title: ProxyConnectionServiceImpl
items.details: isProxyConnected = BLE state is Connected.

items.title: RemoveDevice
items.details: Local removal: device info, scheduler meta, element groups, room membership, scenes, properties, timers, then meshNetwork.deleteNode (exclusion list). Params.ForDevicesWithUUID used by RemoveInvalidDevices.

items.title: RemoveInvalidDevices
items.details: At app start (MainViewModel.observeJungMeshNetwork): locally removes UnknownDevice entries and nodes without AppKey/elements/configComplete (MeshNetworkRepositoryImpl.e2) - no Config Node Reset sent.

items.title: RemoveUser
items.details: Deletes cloud member (and local data if self). Does NOT remove the provisioner from the CDB and does NOT refresh keys.

items.title: ReprovisioningDevice
items.details: Steps ScanForUnprovisionedDevice (60 s) -> RemoveDevice -> ProvisioningDevice -> ConfigureDevice (reconnect Specific 30 s) -> UpdateDeviceName -> Finished; errors ConfigurationOfDeviceFailed, IdentifyOfDeviceFailed, ProvisioningOfDeviceFailed, ReconnectToDeviceFailed, RemoveOfDeviceFailed, WrongStep.

items.title: RequestManufacturerInfos
items.details: SIG Generic Manufacturer Property Get (0x822B) x3: 0x0011 name, 0x001A software version, 0x0010 hardware revision to the element with SIG 0x1012 server.

items.title: RequestSoftwareVersion
items.details: Reads device software version (SIG Generic Manufacturer Property Get 0x822B, property 0x001A) for Params.Devices or AllDevices; AllDevices only while pref request_all_software_versions (default true), then cleared.

items.title: RequestUnknownSoftwareVersionForUpdates
items.details: Requests versions for devices whose version is unknown before update checks.

items.title: ResetDevice
items.details: Node removal: RTR operation-mode reset, delete thresholds, (unless forced) remove other devices' pub/sub pointing at this node's element groups, ConfigNodeReset (0x8049) awaiting 0x804A, RemoveDevice, cloud export. No key refresh afterwards; on failure UI asks for manual factory reset (device_reset_manually_dialog_*).

items.title: ResetNetwork
items.details: Debug "Reset network": ResetDevice(non-forced) for every device (Config Node Reset), resetMeshNetwork (new keys), RemoveLocalData.

items.title: ResetOperationMode
items.details: RTR operation mode reset before node reset.

items.title: ScanUnprovisionedDevices
items.details: Scan for unprovisioned devices, default 30 s (180 s after OTA reset).

items.title: SetProxySettings
items.details: On every proxy connection: look up node by MAC, send ProxyConfigSetFilterType(BLACK_LIST) to 0x0000 and wait <=500 ms for node FilterType == BLACK_LIST_FILTER, else WrongProxySettings. No addresses are added.

items.title: SleepMode
items.details: DeviceAwake / DeviceNotAwake / DeviceNotAvailable states for battery devices.

items.title: TimeKeeperConfiguration
items.details: Time keeper: Time Server publication -> 0xFEFF (period 0), TimeRoleSet 2 (Mesh Time Relay) on keeper; every legacy PP2 node Time Server subscribed to 0xFEFF; removal TimeRoleSet 3 + publication 0x0000. Local group "#time_keeper_group#" 0xFEFF.

items.title: TimeKeeperConfigurationKt
items.details: isTimeKeeper(device): device S1() and its Time Setup capability reports TimeRole == MeshTimeRelay.

items.title: TimeKeeperService
items.details: Ensures time keeper exists (300 ms delay), shows timekeeper dialogs (no_timekeeper_found_*, timekeeper_found_*).

items.title: UpdateConnectionInterval
items.details: requestConnectionPriority(HIGH=1) during provisioning, back to BALANCED (0) afterwards.

items.title: UpdateDevice
items.details: OTA orchestration (Silabs OTA, not mesh DFU): connect by MAC (<=180 s) -> OTA Control 0x00 -> stream .gbl to OTA Data (write-without-response, MTU-3 chunks) -> OTA Control 0x03 + disconnect -> wait 17 s (application) / 120 s (stm) -> reconnect by MAC -> confirm version over mesh (mismatch = WrongSoftwareVersion) -> Time Set -> if storage schema demands reset: re-provision (wait 25 s app / 150 s stm, scan unprovisioned <=180 s) -> DisableProxy for battery devices. Errors DeviceNotConnected, ReprovisioningFailed, UpdateFailed, UpdateFileEmpty, WrongSoftwareVersion.

items.title: UpdateDeviceSettingsForForcedUpdate
items.details: Minimal config for a freshly provisioned device before forced OTA: black-list filter, Composition Data Get, AppKey Add, Default TTL 5, GATT Proxy 1.

items.title: UpdateTimeRole
items.details: Time Role Set wrapper; UpdateTimeRoleError.

items.title: VersionComparison
items.details: Dotted version compare component-wise as integers: GREATER / EQUAL / LOWER / UNKNOWN (UNKNOWN if either is empty, "-" or non-numeric). Range strings "[a,b]" in manifests are not parsed here.

items.title: LowerTransportLayer.isValidSeqAuth
items.details: Replay protection (receive side, segmented): accept iff no SeqAuth stored for src or stored < SeqAuth; equal SeqAuth = duplicate segments of the same message. Unsegmented messages have no replay list check in this library version.

items.title: LowerTransportLayer.parseLowerTransportLayerPDU
items.details: Transport control PDUs: only opcode 0x00 (Segment Acknowledgement) is decoded; every other control opcode (e.g. 0x0A Heartbeat, Friend opcodes) is reported via onUnknownPduReceived and only logged by MeshNotificationChannel. The app neither sends nor evaluates Heartbeats.

items.title: MeshManagerApi.identifyNode
items.details: identifyNode(uuid) = identifyNode(uuid, 5): Provisioning Invite with attention timer 5 s; uses primary NetKey, provisioning flags, current IV index, global TTL.

items.title: MeshManagerApi.parseNotifications
items.details: Beacon handling: authenticate beacon with every NetKey (Tx key = old key in KR phase 1); ignore beacons of non-primary subnets; apply higher IV index or update IV-update flag; RESET provisioner SEQ to 0 when transmit IV index grows; set ivRecoveryFlag when jump > 1 without update flag; purge networkExclusions entries with ivIndex >= key+2 (unless recovering). Other proxy PDU types dispatched (0 network, 2 proxy config, 3 provisioning).

items.title: MeshManagerApi.updateNetworkKeySecurity
items.details: minSecurity of a NetKey is marked insecure when a node is added without OOB public key -> every JUNG export shows security "insecure"; JUNG never reads it.

items.title: MeshMessageState.executeResend
items.details: Transmit SAR: on a received Block Ack, segments not acked are resent once each (createRetransmitMeshMessage, new SEQ). There is no sender-side segment retransmission timer - if no Block Ack arrives nothing is retransmitted; the app-level 3 x 3 s retry covers it.

items.title: NetworkKey.getTxDerivatives
items.details: Key refresh TX key: old key derivatives in phase 1, new key otherwise; RX accepts both (network ID of old key accepted for proxy adverts).

items.title: NetworkLayer.createNetworkLayerPDU
items.details: Network PDU: IVI = LSB of IV index, NID/encryption/privacy keys from k2 of the Tx NetKey, TTL from provisioner node (5; 0 for proxy config), network MIC 4 B (8 B for CTL=1), proxy nonce for proxy config.

items.title: ProvisionedMeshNode.incrementSequenceNumber
items.details: SEQ +1 per network PDU (each segment, each resend, each proxy-config message; createProxyConfigurationMessage consumes one extra). Stored in Nordic Room nodes.seq_number of the provisioner node, not in the JSON export; import keeps max(stored, imported).

items.title: SecureNetworkBeacon.canOverwrite
items.details: IV acceptance: new IV must be > current and <= current+42 (unless allowIvIndexRecoveryOver42, never enabled by JUNG), or equal IV with update-flag transition allowed; plus 96 h-per-step minimum-time rule (isMinimumTimeRequirementCompleted, 192 h cap when recovering) unless IV-update test mode.

items.title: SecureNetworkBeacon.<init>
items.details: Secure Network Beacon parse: exactly 22 bytes; flags bit0 Key Refresh (parsed, never acted on), bit1 IV Update; NetworkID 8 B; IV index 4 B BE; auth 8 B. Beacons arrive via proxy PDU type 1 only (GATT bearer).

items.title: SecureNetworkBeacon.isMinimumTimeRequirementCompleted
items.details: 96 h per IV-update state step since last transition; skipped when transitionDate null; test mode (debug) or recovery flag subtracts one step.

items.title: SecureUtils.calculateHash
items.details: Node Identity hash = bytes 8..15 of AES-ECB(IdentityKey, HASH_PADDING (6 x 0x00) || random(8) || unicast(2)); IdentityKey = k1(NetKey, s1("nkik"), "id128"||0x01). Used by nodeIdentityMatches for proxy selection. The app never enables Node Identity advertising itself (no Config Node Identity Set).

items.title: SecureUtils.calculateK3
items.details: Network ID = k3(NetKey) for proxy advert matching and Secure Network Beacon.

items.details: Invite: attention duration. JUNG identifyNode(uuid) = attention timer 5 s (MeshManagerApi.identifyNode(UUID) -> identifyNode(uuid, 5)).

items.title: Provisioning PDU capabilities (0x01)
items.details: Capabilities: elements, algorithms, public-key type, static/output/input OOB. IdentifyDevice waits max 5 s for it, 3 retries.

items.title: Provisioning PDU start (0x02)
items.details: Start: 03 02 <algorithm=0 FIPS P-256> <publicKey = OOB pubkey only if device offers it> <authMethod = 0 No OOB> 00 00.

items.title: Provisioning PDU public_key (0x03)
items.details: Public Key: 64-byte P-256 public keys exchanged.

items.details: Input Complete: only used with input OOB (never selected by the app).

items.title: Provisioning PDU confirmation (0x05)
items.details: Confirmation (AES-CMAC).

items.title: Provisioning PDU random_confirmation (0x06)
items.details: Random.

items.title: Provisioning PDU data (0x07)
items.details: Data: NetKey index 0, flags (KR/IV update from network), current IV index, unicast address = nextAvailableUnicastAddress(nodes.size(), provisioner).

items.title: Provisioning PDU complete (0x08)
items.details: Complete: node named after scan-list name, (uuid, MAC) stored via DeviceSetupService.

items.title: Provisioning PDU failed (0x09)

items.title: Proxy advert acceptance (0x1828 service data)
items.details: Accept Network-ID adverts (type 0x00, current or old NetKey) or Node-Identity adverts (type 0x01) of any non-provisioner node; additionally the advertiser MAC must be a known device MAC (findDevicesByMacAddress).

items.title: Proxy filter on connect = empty black list
items.details: c.a(dst 0x0000, ProxyConfigSetFilterType(1), statusOpCode 3, src = proxy unicast): phone receives all traffic the proxy relays. Never Remove Address; white list only during configuration.

items.title: FilterType.BLACK_LIST_FILTER = 1
items.details: FilterType 1; set on every proxy connection (empty list => proxy forwards all traffic).

items.title: FilterType.WHITE_LIST_FILTER = 0
items.details: FilterType 0; only during ConfigureDevice (SetWhitelistFilter).

items.title: Proxy configuration SetFilterType (0x00)
items.details: SET_FILTER_TYPE = 0x00. SENT. params 1 byte filter type (0 = white/inclusion list, 1 = black/exclusion list). Proxy config PDUs: proxy PDU type 2, dst 0x0000, TTL 0, CTL 1, proxy nonce. On every proxy connection SetProxySettings sends type=1 (black list, empty => forward everything) and waits <=500 ms for Filter Status; during ConfigureDevice white list then black list.

items.title: Proxy configuration AddAddressToFilter (0x01)
items.details: ADD_ADDRESS = 0x01. SENT during ConfigureDevice (SetWhitelistFilter/SetBlacklistFilter). Quirk: AddProxyFilterAddressesMessageBuilder casts each 16-bit address to a byte and builds AddressArray(b,b) so only 0xFFFF survives intact.

items.title: Proxy configuration RemoveAddressFromFilter (0x02)
items.details: REMOVE_ADDRESS = 0x02. NOT USED by JUNG code (Nordic class only).

items.title: Proxy configuration FilterStatus (0x03)
items.details: FILTER_STATUS = 0x03. RECEIVED: params filterType(1) + listSize(2 BE); Nordic updates local ProxyFilter; JUNG resolvers A0/C1932l1 update the node FilterType used by SetProxySettings check.

items.title: Proxy PDU type 0 (network)
items.details: PDU_TYPE_NETWORK = 0; network PDU (access/control messages). Byte 0 of every GATT PDU = SAR<<6 | type.

items.title: Proxy PDU type 1 (mesh_beacon)
items.details: PDU_TYPE_MESH_BEACON = 1; mesh beacon; incoming beacons are parsed as Secure Network Beacon (22 bytes) against every NetKey. Byte 0 of every GATT PDU = SAR<<6 | type.

items.title: Proxy PDU type 2 (proxy_configuration)
items.details: PDU_TYPE_PROXY_CONFIGURATION = 2; proxy configuration (filter messages). Byte 0 of every GATT PDU = SAR<<6 | type.

items.title: Proxy PDU type 3 (provisioning)
items.details: PDU_TYPE_PROVISIONING = 3; provisioning PDUs over PB-GATT (0x1827 service, 0x2ADB/0x2ADC). Byte 0 of every GATT PDU = SAR<<6 | type.

items.title: Proxy SAR complete
items.details: GATT_SAR_COMPLETE = 0: complete message. Outgoing segmentation applySegmentation(mtu = BLE MTU-3); reassembly appendPdu/removeSegmentation. SAR timeout 20 s (PROXY_SAR_TRANSFER_TIME_OUT) is only armed when the first byte is 0x42 and cancelled on 0xC2 (i.e. only proxy-configuration PDUs); on expiry onIncompleteTimerExpired(0).

items.title: Proxy SAR start
items.details: GATT_SAR_START = 1: first segment, first byte |= 0x40. Outgoing segmentation applySegmentation(mtu = BLE MTU-3); reassembly appendPdu/removeSegmentation. SAR timeout 20 s (PROXY_SAR_TRANSFER_TIME_OUT) is only armed when the first byte is 0x42 and cancelled on 0xC2 (i.e. only proxy-configuration PDUs); on expiry onIncompleteTimerExpired(0).

items.title: Proxy SAR continuation
items.details: GATT_SAR_CONTINUATION = 2: continuation, header byte type|0x80. Outgoing segmentation applySegmentation(mtu = BLE MTU-3); reassembly appendPdu/removeSegmentation. SAR timeout 20 s (PROXY_SAR_TRANSFER_TIME_OUT) is only armed when the first byte is 0x42 and cancelled on 0xC2 (i.e. only proxy-configuration PDUs); on expiry onIncompleteTimerExpired(0).

items.title: Proxy SAR end
items.details: GATT_SAR_END = 3: last segment, header byte type|0xC0. Outgoing segmentation applySegmentation(mtu = BLE MTU-3); reassembly appendPdu/removeSegmentation. SAR timeout 20 s (PROXY_SAR_TRANSFER_TIME_OUT) is only armed when the first byte is 0x42 and cancelled on 0xC2 (i.e. only proxy-configuration PDUs); on expiry onIncompleteTimerExpired(0).
